domain_search.query: "Progressive Health Group of Houston" Mississippi hospital official website
domain_search.basis: https://www.phghouston.com/contact shows 'Progressive Health of Houston', 1002 E Madison St Ste 1, Houston, MS 38851; https://www.ahd.com/free_profile/250017/Progressive_Health_of_Houston/Houston/Mississippi lists CCN 250017 with Hospital Website www.phghouston.com; US News (Trace Regional successor entry, same address) also lists www.phghouston.com. traceregional.com is a parked JS-redirect shell.

checks.note: Body is exactly '<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><script>window.onload=function(){window.location.href="/lander"}</script></head></html>' — a parked redirect shell, not a hospital website.
Same 114-byte JS-redirect shell with text/html content type; not a CMS pointer.
GET returned HTTP 400 text/html; no root pointer published on the real domain.

checks.check: found domain billing page pricing links
checks.note: Wix page. Only prose heading 'What are Standard Charges?'; regex over hrefs for price|charge|transparen|standard|.csv|.json|.zip and for wixstatic/documents links found no MRF or downloadable standard-charges file. Homepage link inventory likewise contains no pricing route.

established: The recorded official_domain traceregional.com is a parked JS redirect shell (114-byte window.location body on every path, including /cms-hpt.txt); it is not the hospital's first-party site.
The first-party official domain for Progressive Health of Houston (CCN 250017, successor of Trace Regional Hospital, 1002 E Madison St, Houston, MS 38851) is www.phghouston.com.
No standard-charges MRF link found on www.phghouston.com/billing-registration on 2026-10-01.
not_established: Whether a facility-specific MRF exists elsewhere on phghouston.com (Wix site; search not exhaustive).
Compliance or exemption status of the facility.
Identity of any MRF file: none was retrieved.
change_vs_prior: Prior finding was 'no-cms-hpt-txt-published' judged against the redirect shell. This proof establishes for the first time that the recorded domain itself is wrong (parked shell) and identifies the correct first-party domain phghouston.com; root pointer on the correct domain is 400.
tools: web-search-prime MCP (search), PowerShell Invoke-WebRequest (bounded GETs, header/regex inspection only)
